name: Never Ask a Woman Her Age
aka: Never Ask a Woman Her Age, a Man His Salary
look: A plain white graphic in three rows. Top: a cartoon woman with a black bob shrugs beside "Never Ask A Woman" and, in red, "Her Age". Middle: a cartoon man in a red tie waves beside "A Man," and, in red, "His Salary". The bottom row is empty.
use: Finishes the old etiquette saying with a third forbidden question. The empty bottom row gets a picture or name of someone plus the touchy subject you should never ask them about, like a student about their plans after graduation.
slots: who you should never ask (picture or name, bottom row left)
the touchy subject (bottom row right, usually in red)
examples: How many hours they've played this week
describe: never ask a woman her age a man his salary meme
cartoon woman and man with etiquette rules and an empty third row
graphic listing things you should never ask people
clip art lady and guy with red text and a blank spot
rude questions meme with a blank space for a third person
origin: Built on the old saying that you should never ask a woman her age or a man his salary.
